text:
maya: Quick finalization thread for GA readiness items. We need owners and clearETA for: SLA doc, private-deploy guide, support escalation map, monitoring alerts, and burst-credit terms. I want this gated cleanly so Sales has a ship date.

eli: I'll take SLA doc. Plan is a short matrix by model family + max_input_tokens and p50/p95/p99 numbers. Will flag exceptions (long-context models). ETA: Wed EOD.

pat: I'll help draft the sample contract clause for Dedicated SLAs and the credit calculation example. Legal review required after draft. ETA: Thu.

sophia: Docs owner for private deploy quickstart + KMS snippet + troubleshooting. Will call out "SLA applicability" banner. ETA: Thu morning.

noah: Oncall mapping: billing -> billing-oncall (24h ack), pricing disputes -> product-escalation (3h), infra incidents -> eng-runtime. I'll update the ops playbook and wire the contact list. ETA: Fri noon.

maya: Monitoring thresholds proposal: p99 > baseline + 20% for 10m; client error rate > 0.5% for 5m; token-cost-per-minute spike > 35% for 10m. Who owns runbooks?

eli: I'll own latency alerts and a short runbook: 1) confirm via 1min/5min windows; 2) check recent rollouts; 3) rollback variant; 4) scale pool or page eng-runtime.

pat: For burst credits: propose a 1M-token pilot window (promotional), then auto-transition to metered billing; include clause "promotional credits expire with 30 days' notice" per Legal.

legal-bot: Confirmed. We'll avoid absolute uptime promises for hosted; Dedicated may have contractual credit tiers.

sophia: I'll add an FAQ entry "Why does performance vary by model?" and link to the SLA applicability banner.

maya: Acceptance checklist (owners): SLA matrix + legal-reviewed text (eli/pat/legal-bot), private deploy docs (sophia), monitoring + runbooks (eli), billing/dashboard metric + rota (noah), burst-credit note + finance signoff (pat). Reply with "ack" + ETA if you agree.

sophia: ack Thu am.

eli: ack Wed EOD.

noah: ack Fri noon.

pat: ack Thu EOD (contract draft).

maya: Great. If all complete by the stated ETAs we'll mark the GA checklist complete and schedule the launch announcement. Drop blockers here.
